effects: Stores _submitAddress as the signer's pending submit address in the queue, and replaces any earlier pending proposal of the signer.
Nothing changes until _submitAddress confirms. No assets, allowances or native value move (not payable).
formats.shown: Intent 'Propose submit address' and the proposed address as 'Submit Address' (addressName).

findings.title: proposeSubmitAddress replaces any earlier pending proposal; the screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: EntityManager.sol proposeSubmitAddress: `submitAddressRegistrationQueue[msg.sender] = _submitAddress;` overwrites the queue slot. Descriptor intent 'Propose submit address'.
findings.fix: Optional: change the intent to 'Propose new submit address (replaces pending)'.

effects: Binds the signer's address as the submit address of _voter, from this block on.
Unbinds the voter's previous submit address, if there was one.
Removes the pending proposal for _voter. The signer cannot remove this binding later; only the voter can replace it with a new proposal.
formats.shown: Intent 'Confirm as submit address for voter' and the voter as 'Voter' (addressName).

findings.title: confirmSubmitAddressRegistration does not say the signer cannot undo the binding to the voter.
findings.evidence: EntityManager.sol confirmSubmitAddressRegistration: `register[_voter].submitAddress.setAddress(msg.sender); submitAddressRegistered[msg.sender].setAddress(_voter);` No function lets msg.sender unregister itself.
findings.fix: Optional: change the intent to 'Become submit address of voter'.

effects: Registers _nodeId to the signer, after the governance-set verifier checks the certificate and signature.
Adds the node ID to the signer's node list, up to maxNodeIdsPerEntity. No assets move.
formats.shown: Intent 'Register node ID' and the node ID as raw hex; the certificate and signature are hidden.

findings.title: registerNodeId shows the node ID as raw hex, not in the usual NodeID- form.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field 'Node Id' format raw on #._nodeId (bytes20). ERC-7730 has no CB58 format.

effects: Removes _nodeId from the signer's node list and frees it. Reverts if the node is not the signer's. No assets move.
formats.shown: Intent 'Unregister node ID' and the node ID as raw hex.

effects: Clears the signer's current public key and frees it. Does nothing if the signer has no key. No assets move.
